classes.name: tiles
classes.reason: tiles are read once per item inside the separate _prefetch worker process, which runs ahead of the main loop and feeds a bounded queue (PREFETCH_DEPTH=8), so the read is overlapped with the main rank's compute/mask work rather than stalling it directly.

classes.name: masks
classes.reason: each item's mask is read synchronously via probe.read_staged(...) in the main loop immediately before the compute sleep, so the issuing rank stops and waits for that single read to finish before proceeding, and only that rank is affected since other ranks/cells run independently with no barrier shown.
